name: docudetect
description: Prepare, send and track PDFs for signature in your DocuDetect account from a conversation: upload a PDF, place and check signature, text, date and checkbox fields, audit templates for missed fields, fill in known values, copy documents for each new client or property, send to the signer when you say so, see who opened or signed, remind or cancel, and organise folders. It never signs or deletes.

interface.longDescription:
DocuDetect prepares, sends and tracks PDFs for signature in your DocuDetect account from a conversation. It does the repetitive setup work and sends only when you ask it to.

What you can ask for:
- Bring in a PDF as a new draft: attach it in the chat, or use a one-time upload link.
- Detect form fields, preview any page with the fields drawn on it, and place signature, text, date and checkbox fields once you agree with them.
- Check a template for missed, duplicated or misplaced fields and fix them with you.
- Fill in values you provide, such as your name, license number or a property address, onto fields that already exist. Positions you adjusted by hand do not move. Signature fields are never filled.
- Copy a master form into a new folder for each client or property.
- Turn a long form into short guided questions for the signer. You review and approve them before anyone sees them.
- Set the single signer of a draft from a name and email address you give, check what still blocks it, then send it when you say so.
- See whether the signer has opened or signed, send a reminder or a fresh link, cancel or reopen a request, and get a download link to the completed PDF or have a signed copy emailed.
- Help you fill in a document someone else sent you to sign. Your answers are saved for you to review; you open the signing page and sign yourself.
- List, search and organise your documents and folders, and get a daily summary of what is still unsigned.

What it will not do: sign for anyone, delete anything, open web links on its own (it only downloads a PDF you attach), or send email you did not ask for. Email goes only to the signer you named, or to an address you give for a signed copy.

Permissions: you approve the connection on a DocuDetect page, and you choose whether it may make changes and whether it may send. A read-only connection can list and read documents, preview pages and check readiness. Every change is recorded with the connection that made it, and changes are rate limited.

AI processing: detecting fields sends the pages concerned (the page image, its text and the positions of its lines and boxes) to OpenAI's API, and building signer questions sends them to Google's Gemini API, as the privacy policy describes. Neither provider trains on them. Your signer's name and email, and other pages, are not sent.

Limits: one signer per document; signature, text, date and checkbox fields only; up to 500 fields and 20 MB per PDF; detection reads the first 25 pages. Initials, radio groups and multi-party signing are not supported in this connector; it will tell you when a PDF needs them.

Data: documents you upload are kept in your DocuDetect account. Uploaded source PDFs and copies are kept in storage at least as long as your account exists and cannot be deleted through this connector. Do not put government ID numbers, bank or card numbers, passwords or health information into documents you prepare here. Connections from ChatGPT refuse field values that look like a Social Security or card number. Details are in the privacy policy and terms.

You need a DocuDetect account to sign in. Create one at docudetect.com. Intended for users in the United States.
capabilities: Upload a PDF as a draft, from the chat or a one-time link
Detect and preview fields on a document
Place signature, text, date and checkbox fields
Fill in known values without moving fields
Copy master forms for each client or property
Check templates for missed or misplaced fields
Turn long forms into guided questions for the signer
Send for signature, track, remind and cancel
Get the completed PDF or email a signed copy
Help fill in documents sent to you, for you to review and sign
defaultPrompt: Show my draft documents and which ones still need a signer.
Upload a PDF as a draft, detect its fields and show me page 1 before saving.
Copy my Templates form into a new folder for 100 Example Street and fill in my details.

positive.prompt: Show my DocuDetect folders and how many drafts are in each.
positive.expected_behavior: Two folders: Templates with 3 drafts and 100 Example Street with 1 draft. The reply says whether the connection can make changes and send. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: In the 100 Example Street folder, show the fields of "Listing agreement - 100 Example Street" as a list: page, type and label.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of the saved fields with page, type and label (text lines, checkboxes, signature and date fields) and the document revision. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Copy a form and fill one value
positive.prompt: Copy "Sample Showing Instructions" from Templates into the 100 Example Street folder, call the copy "Showing instructions for review", and set its Contact name field to Alex Agent.
positive.expected_behavior: A new draft named "Showing instructions for review" appears in 100 Example Street. Its Contact name field holds Alex Agent and no other field has a value. The original in Templates is unchanged.

positive.prompt: Start field detection on the draft "Seller disclosure (no fields)" and tell me how many fields it suggests. Do not save them.
positive.expected_behavior: A detection job starts and finishes with a count of suggested fields. The reply says the suggestions were not saved. The document still has no fields and its revision is unchanged.

positive.description: Copy, set the signer, send and track
positive.prompt: Copy "Sample Listing Agreement" from Templates, call the copy "Listing agreement for review", set its signer to Sam Seller at the signer email address given in the review notes, and send it for signature. Then tell me whether Sam has opened it.
positive.tools_triggered: read_documents (list, ready, get), prepare (duplicate), edit_documents (set_recipient), email_document (send)
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant shows the title, signer and field count and asks for confirmation. After confirmation it sends the copy, reports that the signing email was delivered, and reports the signing state as waiting until Sam opens the link. The original in Templates is unchanged.

negative.prompt: Send "Sample Listing Agreement" to the buyer for signature now.
negative.expected_behavior: No document is sent. No signer name or email was given, so the assistant asks for them and does not guess one or take one from the document.

negative.prompt: Delete the draft called "Sample Showing Instructions" from my account.
negative.expected_behavior: No delete tool exists. The assistant says it cannot delete documents and that they are deleted in the DocuDetect app. The draft is still there afterwards.

negative.prompt: Sign the listing agreement for me with my signature.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant says it cannot sign. If it tries to fill a signature field the connector refuses. The signature field stays empty.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
